title: VendPoint Retired Item Stock Ledger and Vend Error Credit Value
content:
Billing calculation for the vend error credit Corbett owes on a retired item in a VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine.

**The retired item.** The retired item is the item of the customer's contract price line written as a removal carrying the highest change reference on the customer's agreement (removal lines are change lines, whose references Corbett issues in sequence).

**Stock ledger and shortfall.** The retired item's stock ledger is its units loaded on restock visits, less its units vended, plus its units returned to the machine and credited for vend errors, less its units withdrawn and its units billed as shrink, over all of the machine's records, and its shortfall is the amount by which that ledger stands below zero, or zero when it does not.

**The latest vend.** The latest vend is the retired item's vend carrying the highest vend transaction number (the machine log numbers vends in sequence); when the shortfall is above zero and no more than the units of the latest vend, the latest vend is the only vend that dispensed fewer units than it logged, and it is the failed vend.

**When a credit value arises.** A credit value arises only while the shortfall is above zero and no more than the units of the latest vend; a retired item without a shortfall, or without a vend on the machine, is owed no credit.

**The standard credit value.** The standard credit value is the units of the latest vend multiplied by the unit price billed on it and by the late-find share, rounded half up to the cent. The late-find share is 0.5.

**The credit value.** To fix the credit value, each method that applies first replaces the quantity of the standard credit value it names; the shares that apply are then added to the late-find share, that sum never above one, so that no credit exceeds what was billed for the units the vend did not dispense, and the product is rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

### Hypothetical ledger and figure

| Line | Units |
|---|---|
| Loaded on restock visits | 30 |
| Vended | 34 |
| Returned or credited for vend errors | 0 |
| Withdrawn or billed as shrink | 0 |
| Stock ledger | 30 less 34: minus 4 |
| Shortfall | 4 |

With a latest vend of 5 units billed at 10.00 USD each, the shortfall of 4 is above zero and no more than 5, so a credit value arises: 5 multiplied by 10.00 and by 0.5 is 25.00 USD. Had the latest vend been 3 units, the shortfall of 4 would exceed it and no credit value would arise here. All figures are invented.
